title: POWER 3.8 Context and Retrieval Planning Contracts
description: Retained historical v1 planning evidence. SUPERSEDED FOR FUTURE IMPLEMENTATION BY context-retrieval-contracts-v2.schema.json after the protected governance admission. Field meanings are preserved and this schema is not consumed by the current runtime.

ContextItem.description: domain is the primary membership and must be present in domains; runtime validation must enforce that relationship.

ContextBudget.description: Runtime must reject consumed_tokens greater than max_tokens; the standard 2020-12 vocabulary cannot compare two arbitrary instance numbers.

ContextPack.description: Server-derived output. Runtime must enforce profile flags, aggregate token/byte/item limits, and consumed_tokens <= max_tokens before emitting a valid pack.
